title: Whether the band travelled
summary: Willie went to Biloxi and to other places with other bands before she knew him.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Did they ever travel around very much? You mentioned they went to Biloxi.
Yeah, he went to Biloxi, I know.
Did they ever go to Texas or anything?

I don't know. He went different places before he was with me. Because Mama told me he used to always be gone with different bands, different places. But you see, I wasn't with him at the time. That's the trouble. You see. Men used to come get him at the house there and I wouldn't see him no more. Wouldn't even see him no more. He'd be gone. You see, he was busy, you know. He made the living with him. I guess he was trying to catch every way he could catch, you know. Oh, he had plenty of places he played for loads of people. Yes, indeed.
